test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: On 20 July 2021, the Supreme Court struck down certain provisions of part IX B of the Constitution of India. Part IX B was related to:
solution:
The correct answer is__** Co-operative Societies.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The correct answer is option 3, i.e., Co-operative Societies. Part IX B of the Constitution of India deals with the provisions related to the formation and functioning of cooperative societies.**
 
• The Supreme Court has struck down specific provisions of** Part IX B, which means that some rules related to cooperative societies are no longer valid.**
 
• Co-operative societies are formed by a group of individuals who come together to pool their resources and work towards a common goal.
 
• These societies can be formed for various purposes, such as agricultural, industrial, housing, etc.
 
• Cooperative societies play an essential role in the country's socioeconomic development as they provide a platform for the members to work together and achieve their common objectives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Panchayats **- Part IX of the Constitution deals with the provisions related to Panchayats. Panchayats are the local village, intermediate, and district self-government bodies.
 
• **Municipalities **- Part IXA of the Constitution deals with the provisions related to Municipalities. Municipalities are the local self-government bodies at the urban level.
 
• **Sub-ordinate Courts -** Part VI of the Constitution deals with the provisions related to the Union Judiciary. Subordinate courts are the lower courts that operate under the supervision of the higher courts. -
